description: @code/@endcode and @verbatim/@endverbatim blocks keep their line structure and stay positioned among the surrounding prose.
raw:
/**
 * Squares a value.
 * @code{.py}
 *   y = square(3)
 *   if y:
 *       print(y)
 * @endcode
 * Prose written after the block stays after it.
 * @verbatim
 *   +---+
 *   | x |
 *   +---+
 * @endverbatim
 */

detail: Prose written after the block stays after it.
